lifecycle.claim_boundary: This Blueprint is Fractal's only workflow architecture. The immutable System Version pointer identifies which exact implementation commit is active.

element_library.meaning: The complete set of persistent Fractal responsibilities. Every Library Element is classified once before any Flow may use it.

philosophy.core_concept: Use completed work and real outcomes to improve how future work is handled.

protagonist.core_concept: The sole protagonist that turns completed Project evidence into governed improvement of Fractal.

tag_definitions.meaning: A recognisable Fractal function that should retain its core concept without becoming a Genre or changing the element's primary classification.

elements.core_concept: Treat repeated effort and diminishing return as pressure to investigate a better way.
Search beyond the obvious current approach for relevant adjacent and structurally similar ideas.
After genuine success, keep testing whether a materially stronger global outcome is achievable.
Move repeatable and unambiguous work toward deterministic, testable execution.
Protect high-recall discovery before later reasoning narrows the evidence.
Reduce context and system growth by preferring removal, reuse and simplification before addition.
Judge improvement by its global effect instead of a convenient local win.
Retain compact evidence about completed work without becoming a product promise.
Keep Fractal-controlled identities intelligible and governed in the background.

required_steps.trigger: before registering a capability as a user-facing Action or Command
required_steps.completion: A unique semantically justified SF Symbol is recorded, rendered, inspected at real light and dark sizes, projected, and parsed by the staged platform runtime.
required_steps.documentation: `Select User-Surface Symbol` runs before a capability is registered as a user-facing Action or Command. It requires a unique semantically justified SF Symbol, canonical selection evidence, deterministic assets, real-size light/dark inspection, adapter projection, and staged runtime parsing. The maintained procedure is `capabilities/skills/naming-system/references/user-surface-symbols.md`. It remains a required step under `^ Naming System`; it is not another Blueprint Element or System Review Flow.

elements.core_concept: Distinguish existence, loading, callability and successful execution of capabilities.
Connect bounded runtime events to existing Fractal responsibilities without owning them.
Support Fractal in distinguishing claimed improvement from observed reality.
Run a bounded and recoverable trial when evidence is insufficient to judge a Candidate implementation.
Keep every active component identified, classified, permission-bounded, evidenced and recoverable.
Provide operator-visible control and evidence without becoming a product-facing headline.
Keep unclassified donor capabilities inspectable but unable to become persistent Fractal dependencies.
Retain donor source, licence, provenance, mapping, evidence and recovery metadata.
Let replaceable environments execute Fractal without receiving architecture or canonical-state authority.
See From The Big Picture: prevent Agent tunnel vision and harmful local over-investment during a Project.
Use bounded internal and external evidence to improve causal understanding without becoming its own lifecycle.
Challenge a consequential mapped Candidate through genuinely opposing cases before synthesis.
Reuse bounded donor implementations while stripping donor authority and remapping the result to Fractal.

flows.meaning: Ordered rules for using registered Element Library capabilities. A Flow is not a Genre, Element or authority owner.

entries.activation_boundary: System Review starts from completed Project evidence or a verified improvement opportunity.
entries.output: A broad, provenance-linked observation set without premature causes.

entries.activation_boundary: Flow 1 has persisted a valid observation set.
entries.output: Local recurrence groups with surface similarity kept separate from cause.

entries.activation_boundary: Flow 2 has persisted local patterns and comparison scope.
entries.output: Whole-Project pattern candidates linked to local evidence and relevant history.

entries.human_name: Find the Reasons for Every Global Pattern
entries.activation_boundary: Flow 3 has persisted every Global Pattern candidate.
entries.output: A bounded causal account for every Global Pattern, including uncertainty and counterevidence.

entries.human_name: Find Solutions for Every Global Pattern
entries.activation_boundary: Flow 4 has persisted a causal account for every Global Pattern.
entries.output: Multiple evidence-backed Solution Candidates per Global Pattern, including a truthful no-finding result.

entries.human_name: Map New Implementations into the Blueprint
entries.activation_boundary: Flow 5 has persisted its complete Candidate set.
entries.output: Every Candidate is classified against the Element Library and Section 3 rules before debate.

entries.human_name: Debate the Solutions for Every Global Pattern
entries.activation_boundary: Flow 6 has mapped or honestly rejected every Candidate.
entries.output: Independent opposing cases and a reconciled recommendation for every decision unit.

entries.activation_boundary: Flow 7 has completed both opposing cases and reconciliation.
entries.output: One prepared human decision at a time, with the remaining queue visible and no automatic activation.

blueprint_change_rules.meaning: Rules that govern any addition, removal, merge, replacement or reclassification of the Element Library or Flows.

modification_rules.deuteragonist_contract: Preserve the core concept; freely improve, replace, merge or subtract its implementation without losing the responsibility.
modification_rules.extra_contract: Keep it outside the product emphasis; add it only when a Protagonist or Deuteragonist needs supporting infrastructure.
modification_rules.prop_contract: Keep it reusable, callable where relevant and replaceable by a stronger method; it never owns an Action, lifecycle or authority boundary.
modification_rules.principle_contract: Treat it as an asymptotic direction that cannot be claimed complete; add one only after accumulated Global Patterns and repeated causal work.
